rv.q: Her sharp observations and crackling dialogue were evident in her earlier playwriting, too and, in director Rhiann Jeffery's taut new production, feel fresh and current.

She was among the many readers who saw themselves in the characters’ struggles; the book became a national bestseller and introduced a boom of memoirs about young women and mental illness. Zollo later brought the idea of adaptation to her parents, both producers; her mother, Barbara Broccoli, controlled the James Bond franchise for decades.
